name: Lemonade Lake Fruit Boats
description: A giant lake of sparkling lemonade with fruit-slice boats and straw islands.
prompt: A single playful fantasy scene: a vast lake of sparkling golden lemonade under a bright summer sky, boats made from hollowed citrus halves, tiny people sailing with paper umbrellas, islands of ice cubes and mint leaves, lemon slices floating like suns, fizzy bubbles, vibrant colors, whimsical scale, high detail, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Summer, but make it a whole lake. 🍋⛵
